value: GA3 (10 and 100 uM) accelerated in vitro germination of dormant seeds (maximum germination 77% and 72% against 66% in the control by the Results text), but never reached the BAP 100 uM treatment (85% after 60 days); no statistical test reported
method: in vitro seed germination on culture medium with N6-benzylaminopurine (BAP), gibberellic acid (GA3) and fluridone (FLU) at 10 and 100 uM, plus an untreated control
conditions: 25 +/- 2 C, cool white fluorescent light 50 umol m-2 s-1, 16 h light / 8 h dark, germination counted daily for 60 days; four replicates of 25 seeds per dish; seeds from fruits harvested in 2010 in the Libertador Bernardo O'Higgins region, soaked six days then stored three months at 4 C; abstract: control reached 27% at 30 days and BAP 100 uM 74%; GA3 and FLU 10 and 100 uM reached maximum germination of 77/72% (GA3) and 74/75% (FLU), BAP 79% (10 uM) and 85% (100 uM); the abstract says GA3 and FLU germination started after a lag phase while the Results text says GA3 germination started around day 10, and no statistical test is reported for the comparisons

source.authors: Rodríguez Beraud M, Tampe Pérez J
source.title: Effects of gibberellic acid, N6-benzylaminopurine and fluridone on the in vitro germination of Aristotelia chilensis

quote: However, maximum germination never achieved the one obtained by the BAP 100 μM treatment with 85 % after 60 days.
note: Vol. 38 No. 3 (2017), Short Communications, pages 593-597 and the DOI as printed in the PDF citation.
